**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Central Science Team within Amazon’s People Experience and Technology org (PXTCS) uses economics, behavioral science, statistics, and machine learning to proactively identify mechanisms and process improvements which simultaneously improve Amazon and the lives, well-being, and the value of work to Amazonians. We are an interdisciplinary team, which combines the talents of science and engineering to develop and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal.  
  
We are looking for an Applied Scientist to build production machine learning solutions that improve employee experiences and inform workforce decisions. You will work on problems spanning predictive modeling, natural language processing, recommendation systems, personalization, generative AI, and causal evaluation. These solutions will predict workforce outcomes, identify individual and organizational needs, recommend targeted actions, and measure the causal impact of programs, products, and policies across diverse employee populations and business contexts.  
  
As an Applied Scientist, you will develop models and algorithms from prototype through production. You will collaborate with other scientists and economists to combine machine learning with causal inference and experimentation, allowing teams to understand both what is likely to happen and which actions will improve outcomes. You will also work with product managers, engineers, and business partners to translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate methods and results to technical and nontechnical audiences.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning solutions in production environments.
* Develop solutions using techniques that include predictive modeling, deep learning, natural language processing, recommendation systems, personalization, and generative AI.
* Build models that predict workforce outcomes, identify employee and organizational needs, and recommend targeted actions.
* Partner with economists and other scientists to design causal evaluations and experimental frameworks that measure the impact of programs, products, and policies.
* Combine predictive models with causal estimates to help business partners identify effective actions and make evidence-based decisions.
* Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business partners to translate business requirements into modeling approaches and contribute to technical design and roadmap decisions.
* Evaluate model accuracy, performance, calibration, and limitations, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Communicate technical concepts, methods, results, and recommendations to technical peers and business partners.

  
A day in the life  

* Analyze data to investigate model performance or understand an unexpected result from a causal evaluation.
* Brainstorm modeling and evaluation approaches with applied scientists and economists on the team.
* Develop and test model features, recommendation methods, or generative AI applications.
* Design or analyze experiments and observational studies to estimate the causal impact of programs, products, or policies.
* Run simulations, offline evaluations, or backtests to assess model performance.
* Meet with product, engineering, and business partners to review requirements, data, designs, and implementation decisions.
* Review code changes or technical design documents from scientists and engineers.
* Write and present documents covering methods, results, limitations, and recommendations.

The People eXperience and Technology Central Science Team (PXTCS) uses economics, behavioral science, statistics, and machine learning to proactively identify mechanisms and process improvements which simultaneously improve Amazon and the lives, wellbeing, and the value of work to Amazonians. We are an interdisciplinary team that combines the talents of science and engineering to develop and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal.

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of applied research experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in professional software development

### **About Us**

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

### **About the Role**

Twitch's Enterprise Platform & Technology (EPT) organization is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build agentic AI systems on AWS that power Finance and enterprise functions across Twitch and Amazon. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll design and ship MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, Bedrock-based agents, and Claude-powered workflows, and own the AWS-native infrastructure behind them end-to-end (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate, CDK).

You'll work at the intersection of modern AI tooling and production cloud engineering, connecting AI agents to enterprise systems and data, automating manual operational work, and turning emerging AI capabilities into reliable, secure, observable services. The business problems are well understood; how you solve them with AWS + AI is up to you. We're looking for an engineer who stays current with the AI tooling landscape (models, agent frameworks, coding assistants, MCP), uses these tools heavily every day, and raises the bar on automation for the whole team.

### **You Will**

*Build agentic AI systems*

* Build MCP servers that give AI agents and assistants (Claude, Amazon Q, Kiro, and internal tools) secure access to enterprise data and actions, including through Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
* Build Bedrock agents and Claude-powered workflows (using AgentCore, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Strands Agents, or LangGraph) that automate Finance work like reconciliations, reporting, variance analysis, and payouts
* Evaluate and adopt new AI tools, models, and patterns as they emerge; turn prototypes into production-grade services
* Design for safety and trust through prompt/tool design, guardrails, human-in-the-loop approvals, evaluation, and auditability

*Build on AWS*

* Build and run the AWS services that host the agents and integrations (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, ECS/Fargate)
* Manage infrastructure with CDK, including CI/CD, IAM, VPC connectivity, secrets management, and beta/gamma/prod environments
* Develop data pipelines between enterprise apps, Redshift, and S3, and make that data available to AI agents
* Set up monitoring for agents and services (CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms, tracing)

*Cross-cutting*

* Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and Tax stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions
* Own production systems end-to-end, from deployment and monitoring to incident response and iterative improvement
* Raise the team's bar through code reviews, docs, mentoring, and promoting AI-assisted development

### **You Have**

*AI and Agents*

* Demonstrated heavy use of AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Kiro, Amazon Q Developer, or similar) integrated into your daily engineering workflow for code generation, data analysis, automation, and problem-solving
* Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic API, or similar), including prompt design, tool calling, and structured outputs
* Working knowledge of the current AI tooling landscape, including MCP, agent frameworks, RAG patterns, and model selection trade-offs

*AWS and Engineering*

* 4+ years of professional software development experience
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating production workloads on AWS (Lambda, S3, Step Functions, DynamoDB, IAM, API Gateway, or similar)
* Proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript with a track record of shipping production code
* Experience writing, deploying, and reviewing infrastructure-as-code (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation) in a team setting

* Experience designing, testing, and debugging APIs (REST, JSON, OpenAPI) using tools like Bruno or Postman, including building request collections, handling authentication flows, and validating response contracts
* Understanding of OAuth 2.0 authorization flows (authorization code, client credentials) and OpenID Connect (OIDC) for securing APIs and agent-to-service access

### **Bonus Points**

* AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer, DevOps Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or AI Practitioner)
* Experience shipping MCP servers, Bedrock agents, or other agentic systems to production, using tools like AgentCore, Strands Agents, or LangGraph
* Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, and guardrails (hallucination checks, cost/latency optimization, prompt versioning)
* Experience with RAG and vector stores (Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, or S3 Vectors)

* Experience integrating with enterprise systems (ERP, procurement, payments platforms)
* Experience with SAP development (ABAP, OData, or integrations)

**The role**
------------

**Build Our Future Together**

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Clinical Bioinformatician to join the Regeneron Clinical Genomics Laboratory and lead the optimization, validation, and production support of NGS-based bioinformatics pipelines in a regulated clinical diagnostic environment. The ideal candidate will bring a proven track record in a CLIA-regulated laboratory, the ability to work independently, and strong communication skills to collaborate across scientific, operational, and leadership teams.

  
  

**When & where:**

* Work Location: Tarrytown, NY
* Hybrid: 4 days per week on site
  

  

**Discover your role:**

* NGS pipeline validation & optimization**:** Lead or co-lead analytical validation and revalidation of NGS bioinformatics pipelines for clinical assays, including germline and future disease applications. Optimize sensitivity, specificity, limit of detection, and variant allele fraction thresholds using clinical samples and in silico data sets. Define and document pipeline configurations, filtering criteria, and QC thresholds in accordance with AMP/CAP best practice guidelines and applicable CLIA, CAP, and state regulatory requirements.
* Bioinformatics tool evaluation & selection**:** Benchmark and select tools for alignment, variant calling, annotation, and quality control based on assay design, specimen type, and sequencing platform. Inform build-versus-buy decisions through technical evaluation of vendor-supplied pipeline solutions.
* Production pipeline operations**:** Oversee daily execution of validated clinical pipelines and monitor performance across sequencing runs and patient samples through QC programs and key performance indicators. Troubleshoot pipeline failures, data quality issues, and software errors; escalate complex problems to the Laboratory Director as appropriate.
* Change management & version control**:** Support pipeline updates through impact assessment, revalidation planning, and change documentation. Apply version control best practices throughout development and release to maintain traceability and regulatory compliance.
* Pipeline development support**:** Contribute to the design and development of new or updated pipelines, incorporating selected tools, containerization, and workflow orchestration.
* Data management & regulatory compliance**:** Manage genomic and patient data in accordance with applicable privacy laws and federal, state, and institutional data security policies. Maintain audit-ready records of pipelines, validation studies, software versions, and standard operating procedures. Support data integrity through verification, sample identifier management, and audit logging.
* Cost monitoring & resource management**:** Track and report cloud compute and storage usage, software license costs, and vendor tool expenditures. Flag cost trends and anomalies, identify savings opportunities that preserve clinical performance and compliance, and provide usage data and trend summaries to support leadership’s budget planning.
  

  
  

**This role requires:**

* Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, or a related field. A Bachelor's degree with substantial hands-on experience in a CLIA-regulated clinical genomics or molecular diagnostics laboratory is accepted in lieu of a Master's degree.
* 2–4 years of experience in a clinical molecular diagnostics or clinical genomics laboratory, with demonstrated hands-on NGS bioinformatics pipeline validation experience in a CLIA-regulated setting
* Proven experience performing or supporting NGS bioinformatics pipeline validation in a CLIA-regulated clinical laboratory, including establishing sensitivity, specificity, limit of detection, and VAF thresholds
* Experience with short-read sequencing data from high-throughput platforms, including run-level and sample-level QC, demultiplexing, and troubleshooting data quality issues
* Hands-on experience validating, configuring, and supporting commercial or vendor-supplied secondary analysis and variant interpretation platforms in a clinical setting, including managing software updates, settings, and filtering criteria
* Working knowledge of NGS file formats (FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF) and standard tools for alignment, variant calling, annotation, and quality control, with the ability to benchmark vendor and open-source tools against one another
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments and in Python or R, including scripting for QC, data analysis, and integration or automation around vendor platforms

The Amazon Advertising Identity Platform (AIP) powers identity resolution across Amazon's owned and operated properties, third party publishers, and the open internet. As traditional identity signals become less available and consumer behavior spans more devices and environments, understanding the accuracy, coverage, and business impact of identity resolution has become increasingly important.  
  
As a Data Scientist II, you will develop analytical frameworks, measurement methodologies, and data driven insights to evaluate the performance of Amazon's identity graph. You will design experiments, develop statistical models, and establish measurement frameworks to understand how identity improvements translate into better advertising outcomes. This includes evaluating the precision and recall of identity models, measuring the incremental contribution of individual identity sources, identifying gaps in identity coverage, and quantifying the commercial impact of identity investments.  
  
You will partner closely with applied scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business leaders to translate complex data into actionable recommendations. Your work will help shape technical priorities, guide investment decisions, and establish the metrics used to evaluate identity performance across Amazon Advertising.

new_jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

**The role**

Every hour our operators work produces hours of synchronized video, robot state, and actions, and that data is a core product. You'll own the path from robot site to a searchable, trustworthy dataset that our researchers train on and our customers buy. You'll also run the infrastructure that keeps a growing, geographically spread fleet updated, monitored, and healthy.

**What you'll do**

* Own data storage and lifecycle: ingest from sites, object storage layout, retention, tiering, and cost.
* Build the catalog: episode metadata, task labels, operator and robot info, quality flags, and search, so anyone can find "all successful pick-and-place episodes on arm model X last month."
* Build automated quality checks: dropped frames, sync drift, missing streams, failed or truncated episodes.
* Build dataset export and delivery: convert raw episodes into the formats training teams and customers expect, with versioning and provenance.
* Handle data governance: access control, customer and site data agreements, privacy (faces, sensitive scenes on site), and audit trails for data we sell.
* Run fleet infrastructure: provisioning edge machines at sites, remote software deploys and rollbacks, secrets, VPN/connectivity, monitoring, and alerting.
* Keep cloud costs and bandwidth under control as data volume grows.
* Build dashboards to monitor data collection status and progress

**What we're looking for**

* 3-4 years as a data, platform, or infrastructure engineer owning production systems end to end.

### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

**The role**

Every hour our operators work produces hours of synchronized video, robot state, and actions, and that data is a core product. You'll own the path from robot site to a searchable, trustworthy dataset that our researchers train on and our customers buy. You'll also run the infrastructure that keeps a growing, geographically spread fleet updated, monitored, and healthy.

**What you'll do**

* Own data storage and lifecycle: ingest from sites, object storage layout, retention, tiering, and cost.
* Build the catalog: episode metadata, task labels, operator and robot info, quality flags, and search, so anyone can find "all successful pick-and-place episodes on arm model X last month."
* Build automated quality checks: dropped frames, sync drift, missing streams, failed or truncated episodes.
* Build dataset export and delivery: convert raw episodes into the formats training teams and customers expect, with versioning and provenance.
* Handle data governance: access control, customer and site data agreements, privacy (faces, sensitive scenes on site), and audit trails for data we sell.
* Run fleet infrastructure: provisioning edge machines at sites, remote software deploys and rollbacks, secrets, VPN/connectivity, monitoring, and alerting.
* Keep cloud costs and bandwidth under control as data volume grows.
* Build dashboards to monitor data collection status and progress

**What we're looking for**

* 3-4 years as a data, platform, or infrastructure engineer owning production systems end to end.
* Experience with large unstructured data (video, sensor logs, images) in object storage, not only tabular warehouses.
* Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with infrastructure-as-code, containers, and CI/CD.
* You've built pipelines with real failure handling: retries, idempotency, backfills, and monitoring.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with robotics or autonomous-vehicle data, or ML training data pipelines.
* Edge fleet management: deploying to many remote Linux devices on unreliable networks.
* Experience packaging and delivering datasets to external customers.
* Familiarity with data privacy rules across multiple countries.
